classification_rationale: Trigger (block.timestamp/block.number read, especially in a value/timing-sensitive decision) is straightforward to detect via Slither's IR (solidity_variables_read for block.timestamp/block.number). Semantic condition ('does this introduce MEV or similar vulnerability') needs judgment -- e.g. a timestamp used only for a multi-day unlock check is far lower-risk than one used for a same-block price/auction decision.

implementation_status.test: rtf/l5_predicates/test_predicates.py -- specifically verified it catches block.prevrandao (the exact gap found in Slither's own weak-prng detector) and non-modulo timestamp usage
implementation_status.note: Only the deterministic trigger (any read of block.timestamp/now/block.number/block.prevrandao/block.difficulty) is implemented -- the semantic condition ('is this sufficiently resistant to prediction' / 'does this introduce MEV risk') requires L8 LLM Judgment Layer execution against real code, not yet run.
